Entries.Title: Love Me to Death
Entries.Description: Elite office worker Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and his wife Mio (Miori Takimoto) were living a smooth-sailing married life. But one day, Mio realizes that a photo sent by Masato, who was supposed to be away on a business trip, is an alibi photo he picked up from the internet. A hint of doubt is brought into their peaceful daily life. Furthermore, a "murder of a female journalist" has occurred in the neighborhood, and it has been making the news day after day with the culprit still at large. Something begins to fall apart behind the scenes of their happy marriage...

Episodes.Title: Bluebird
Episodes.Description: Elite office worker Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and his wife Mio (Miori Takimoto) were living a smooth-sailing married life. But one day, Mio realizes that a photo sent by Masato, who was supposed to be away on a business trip, is an alibi photo he picked up from the internet. A hint of doubt is brought into their peaceful daily life. Furthermore, a "murder of a female journalist" has occurred in the neighborhood, and it has been making the news day after day with the culprit still at large. Something begins to fall apart behind the scenes of their happy marriage...

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Day
Episodes.Description: Detective Tomizawa (Yamaguchi Makiya) visits Mio Kamishiro (Takimoto Miori), who works at a patisserie, to investigate the "murder of a female journalist." The victim, Yuhi Minamizawa (Kumada Rinka), frequently visited the patisserie, despite not liking sweets. Furthermore, a mysterious man (Hosoda Yoshihiko) who moved into the room next to the Kamishiro couple has been watching and eavesdropping on Masato Kamishiro (Narimiya Hiroki) and Mio. Meanwhile, a new incident unfolds.

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Poison
Episodes.Description: Ayaka Koizumi (Miku Tanaka), a colleague of Mio Kamishiro (Mio Takimoto), is found dead. Pastry chef Joji Oyamada (Jin Katagiri), who had been threatened by Ayaka, is being investigated as a key witness in the murder of female journalist Yuhi Minamizawa (Rinka Kumada ). Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) tries to calm the anxious Mio, but behind the scenes he has been meeting with investor Masumi Nagano (Mariko Tsutsui). Masato's true colors are starting to come out...

Episodes.Title: Monster's Tail
Episodes.Description:
Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and Mio (Mio Takimoto) promise to hold their wedding just the two of them on their wedding anniversary trip.

In fact, Masato has taken out a large amount of life insurance on Mio and is planning to kill her during the trip. Mizuki Segawa (Reina Matsui), a psychiatrist, is worried that Mio's dependency on Masato is getting worse. Meanwhile, Souma Ishiguro (Yoshihiko Hosoda), who believes Masato is the real culprit of the murder, travels to Kobe to trace the past of Masato, an orphan of the earthquake disaster. Why did Yuhi Minamizawa (Rinka Kumada) have to be killed?

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of theEnd
Episodes.Description: Ishiguro Souma (Hosoda Yoshihiko) visits Detective Tomizawa (Yamaguchi Makiya) with the interview data on Kamishiro Masato (Narimiya Hiroki) that Minamizawa Yuhi (Kumada Rinka) risked her life to obtain. The data reveals a truth about Masato that is hard to believe. Masato's past and true nature are revealed. What is Masato planning?

Episodes.Title: I Won't Kill You
Episodes.Description: The true identity of Kamishiro Masato (Narimiya Hiroki) is gradually revealed. Detective Inspector Tomizawa (Yamaguchi Makiya) decides to start the investigation into the murders of Minamisawa Yuhi (Kumada Rinka) and Koizumi Ayaha (Minamisawa Yuhi) from scratch. Meanwhile, Masato and Mio (Takimoto Miori) are preparing for their wedding anniversary trip. Masato's plan to murder Mio for the insurance money reaches its final stage. His former lover Nagano Masumi (Tsutsui Mariko) appears. Meanwhile, Ishiguro Souma (Hosoda Yoshihiko) contacts Mio and the turbulent final chapter begins.

Episodes.Title: For the One You Love
Episodes.Description: Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and Mio set off on an anniversary trip to plan the murder of Mio (Miori Takimoto). Souma Ishiguro (Yoshihiko Hosoda) chases after them to stop them, but Masato notices them. Meanwhile, the police are in an uproar after it is revealed that Masato's ex-wife, Aya Kamishiro (Noriko Aoyama), was also murdered. Mio has complete faith in Masato. In an empty chapel, the two of them hold a wedding ceremony, but a desperate chase between Masato, Ishiguro, and the police begins.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Killed Love
Episodes.Description: Mio Kamishiro (Miori Takimoto) and Souma Ishiguro (Yoshihiko Hosoda) desperately try to escape Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya), but he gradually closes in on them. When they can no longer escape, what decision will Mio make? Where will the "ultimate love" of the murderer Masato and Mio lead...?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In the 1980s, Balder feels embarrassed when his friends find one of his father's films. Back at the christening party, Balder locks up Bjørnar in the basement when he threatens to disclose Balder's yet another secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Balder makes an aggressive attempt to finish the christening quickly. In the 1990s, Norway bans pornographic films, forcing Anne-Lise to return to her teaching job. Back at the christening, Balder finally loses it completely.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The day ends and no baby has been baptized. Instead, Lars hosts a party on his boat, but Balder interrupts the karaoke to share something with everyone. Back in the 1990s, Balder and Bjørnar nearly escape a police raid.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The events of the failed christening have Helle ready to leave Balder, but he gets one last chance to make things right. In the past, Lars and Bjørnar are arrested outside Remy's sex shop with a van full of illegal porn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The orphanage director Maged acts as guarantor to get Welaa, Moftah, Almaz and Atayef released after they steal a bag. As Tahani decides to document the orphanage's violations under Maged's supervision, Maged threatens her to delete the photos, so she tells him that she sent them to the editor-in-chief.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Welaa and Moftah steal the editor-in-chief's phone on Maged's orders to get rid of the photos. Obaid tries to commit suicide because of Maged, so Welaa decides not to give the phone to Maged. Atayef tries to help Tahani escape from the orphanage, and Sahar refuses to marry Welaa, so he gets depressed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While escaping from the orphanage, Tahani discovers documents that incriminate Maged, so she takes them to the editor-in-chief. Atayef tries to look for her after he becomes attracted to her. Maged asks Welaa and Moftah to go to Yassin Al Haddad's villa to steal important documents that belong to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Welaa and Moftah bring the files from Yassin, and the editor-in-chief tells Tahani that he lost the data, so they quarrel and he fires her. Amina agrees to marry Khedr, and it is revealed that Souad is working for Maged. Welaa goes to Sahar after she agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sayed rebukes his mother for her intention to marry Welaa, so the marriage is cancelled. Souad asks Maged for money in exchange for telling him information about Moftah, and Yassin agrees with Welaa to give him information about his mother’s location in exchange for recovering the stolen file.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Almaz decides to leave the orphanage after turning eighteen, and Welaa and Moftah take the children of the orphanage to an apartment they rented using Maged's money, but the latter follows them, which puts them in an unexpected confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Maged rebukes Welaa and Moftah, takes the money, and returns to the orphanage with the children, but he discovers that the file that Atayef stole is missing. Atayef tests Tahani's loyalty to him by telling her that he will not give her the file, so she decides not to meet him again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Amina asks Obaid to stay away from her because he abandoned her under Maged's threats. Obaid tells Maged that Atayef is the one who stole the file, so Maged decides to take revenge on him by killing him with poison to make it look like a natural death. Moftah discovers that Souad has lied to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Obaid decides to kill Maged, but he then backs down. Tahani asks Moftah to bring the file, so Moftah and Welaa grow suspicious of the reason for Atayef's death. Maged tempts Souad with money into driving a wedge between Welaa and Moftah, so she goes to confess her love to Welaa, and Sahar sees them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: After Welaa and Moftah confirm Maged's involvement in Atayef's murder, they lock him in and decide to take control of the orphanage and run it, but Maged tries to manipulate Welaa's feelings, telling him that his mother is still alive and that he knows where she is.

Episodes.Title: The Devourer (1)
Episodes.Description: Three years have passed from the Nihonbashi incident. Jinya hears talk of street killings occurring near a soba shop. The number of dead don't match the number of missing.

Episodes.Title: The Devourer (2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Natsu get attacked by the slasher thought to be a demon. After Mosuke arrives to help and Jinya brandishes his blade, the demon quickly vanishes into the darkness.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Happiness (1)
Episodes.Description: In the fall of 1853, a samurai by the name of Naotsugu Miura grows concerned about his missing brother. However, everyone insists that he doesn't have a brother.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Happiness (2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Naotsugu witness a young girl losing her parents in a fire, which brings the unexpected truth of the mystery to light.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Night of Kudanzaka
Episodes.Description: In the winter of 1853, Jinya is hired by Jyuuzou to investigate a demonic painting known as "the Ukiyo-e of Kudanzaka" that's said to be cursed.

Episodes.Title: Blossoming Dreams of the Kanzashi (1)
Episodes.Description: In the spring of 1854, rumors spread of a demon woman who kills men in the Yoshiwara redlight district. Jinya investigates.

Episodes.Title: Blossoming Dreams of the Kanzashi (2)
Episodes.Description: A man named Somegorou Akitsu gifts Natsu a hairpin then crosses paths with Jinya. Somegorou's spirit dogs attack Jinya and he must use his demon powers to defend himself.

Episodes.Title: Harlot in the Rain
Episodes.Description: In May of 1855, Naotsugu and a woman in a kimono catch sight of a man in the distance who looks different to both. Naotsugu sees his brother and the woman sees an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (1)
Episodes.Description: In winter of 1856, Zenji brings a liquor to the soba shop and it becomes immensely popular. However, Jinya finds something unsavory about it.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (2)
Episodes.Description: A series of violent incidents occur across Edo, all related to Yuki-no-Nagori. Worse yet, rumors of a woman with blonde hair send chills down Jinya's spine.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (3)
Episodes.Description: It turns out Yuki-no-Nagori is an evil drink. Jinya finds a demon calling out the name "Jinta". As they face off, Jinya suffers from the weakness of his own heart.

Episodes.Title: Embodiment of Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Back in the winter of 1839, when Jinya was still just Jinta, there were rumors of strange phenomena occurring near the Modori River. Byakuya orders Jinta to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Late Night Tales of Demonic Swords ~Hijin~
Episodes.Description: The year is 1862. The arrival of the Perry Expedition in Japan brings unrest into the cities. Jinya hears about a cursed sword called the "Yatonomori Kaneomi."

Episodes.Title: Logic of the Amanojaku
Episodes.Description: In July of 1863, Jinya hears rumors of a demon in Mizuho temple that devours humans. Upon visiting, Jinya comes across a silver-haired fox demon.

Episodes.Title: By the Sword
Episodes.Description: In March of 1864, a job comes to Jinya to slay a demon named Okada. Okada has become a crazed murderer willing to kill anyone from fellow samurai to women and children.

Episodes.Title: A Chat Over Tea
Episodes.Description: In September of 1867, Somegoro Akitsu leaves Kyoto with a tea set that he takes to Jinya. Akitsu wants to find someone who can use the set to conduct a tea ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Change
Episodes.Description: Jinya and his daughter, Nomari, enjoy peaceful days staying with Naotsugu and his family. However, time changes all things and their world faces a drastic transformation.

Episodes.Title: Wish (Part 1)
Episodes.Description: While engaged in a fierce battle with Tsuchiura, Jinya is forced to take on his demonic form, witnessed by both Naotsugu and Nomari.

Episodes.Title: Wish (Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Tsuchiura face off during a heavy rainstorm. When Jinya's demon arm begins to throb, it sparks a resonance that allows them to experience each other's pasts.

Episodes.Title: Surprise visit
Episodes.Description: After receiving a message on his phone, Moussa heads to his family home in Damascus, where he discovers a secret that could change his life.

Episodes.Title: Family Dispute
Episodes.Description: Moussa tries to find a way out of his predicament, as Muhib arrives at the police station with an important file in hand.

Episodes.Title: The Fragment
Episodes.Description: Alajan and Moussa have an agreement on the next operation, as Moussa meets Belqis at the printshop.

Episodes.Title: The Theft
Episodes.Description: Alajan leaves no stone unturned in search of the stolen money. Belqis makes a reckless move, landing her in trouble with Moussa.

Episodes.Title: The Tank
Episodes.Description: After Zain gets into a serious accident, Belqis’s past comes knocking. Moussa races against time to get back the stolen money.

Episodes.Title: The Watch
Episodes.Description: To save his brother, Moussa finds himself forced to work with Belqis. Elsewhere, Mayyas’s interrogation takes a bad turn.

Episodes.Title: All Over Again
Episodes.Description: Dalal confronts Alajan about interfering in her business. Moussa plans the next step with Belqis. Later, Alajan begins suspecting that Belqis is doing business behind his back.

Episodes.Title: The Ink
Episodes.Description: Belqis visits her father with questions about a mission. Rama lashes out at Zain for not helping her brother. Meanwhile, Alajan’s men close in on Moussa.

Episodes.Title: The Report
Episodes.Description: As more and more fake bills circulate, Fajr finds himself under pressure to find the source. Belqis and the group double down on printing new notes.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: As Lilas and Anas dig themselves into a hole, Belqis gets into trouble with Alajan. Elsewhere, Fajr tries to find new leads in his investigation.

Episodes.Title: Alarm Bell
Episodes.Description: Believing he’s in Fajr’s crosshairs, Moussa tries to put a plan together to avoid ending up behind bars.

Episodes.Title: The Trap
Episodes.Description: Alajan plants bugs at the new printing location, as Nizar decides to keep tabs on Moussa.

Episodes.Title: Under Process
Episodes.Description: As Moussa is assigned to investigate Nizar’s disappearance, the group picks up the pace of the operation.

Episodes.Title: Deep Down Under
Episodes.Description: After finding the listening device, Moussa tries to get the group out of their predicament. Meanwhile, Belqis is summoned to the police station.

Episodes.Title: A Pro Move
Episodes.Description: Belqis suffers an accident at the holding cell, as the deadline for delivering the last money batch draws near.

Episodes.Title: The Interrogation
Episodes.Description: Fajr starts interrogating the suspects. Meanwhile, Alajan realises that the newly-printed money is gone.

Episodes.Title: The Circle
Episodes.Description: As Belqis tries to reach an agreement with Alajan, Mazin changes his testimony, further complicating matters.

Episodes.Title: The Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Moussa is blackmailed into going to the print shop. Mazin demands a sum of money from Alajan in exchange for his silence.

Episodes.Title: Al Embrator
Episodes.Description: As news about his arrest spreads, Rana and Muhib try to help Moussa, who later has an encounter that could turn the tide.

Episodes.Title: No Limits
Episodes.Description: Alajan makes Belqis an offer she can’t resist. Elsewhere, the court reaches a verdict in the murder case.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding
Episodes.Description: A vengeful Alajan decides to make Belqis suffer. Moussa begins life after prison with a new business.

Episodes.Title: Police Magazine
Episodes.Description: With Fajr breathing down his neck, Moussa starts looking for a new printing spot.

Episodes.Title: Subpoena
Episodes.Description: Following the car explosion, Moussa receives a subpoena from the Political Security Directorate.

Episodes.Title: In The Salon
Episodes.Description: Mayyas finds out that Rama is working for Alajan. Meanwhile, Moussa comes up with a way to bring down those who did him wrong.

Episodes.Title: The Birthday Party
Episodes.Description: As his business takes a hit, Moussa suspects there’s a traitor in the circle. Elsewhere, Belqis plans a birthday surprise for her husband.

Episodes.Title: The Surprise
Episodes.Description: As his relationship with his sister becomes strained, Moussa tries to bury the hatchet with Belqis. Later, he turns to Al Embrator to deal with Imad.

Episodes.Title: Box Of Sweets
Episodes.Description: As Moussa and Rama take their relationship to the next level, Belqis starts plotting against her husband with Alajan.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: Moussa asks Belqis for forgiveness, as he finds himself under immense pressure from Imad. Meanwhile, Alajan tries to get back in the game.

Episodes.Title: Last Minute
Episodes.Description: Belqis finds herself caught in the crossfire between Imad, Alajan, and Moussa. Later, Moussa rushes to the rescue as Rama’s life hangs in the balance.

Episodes.Title: Made In Syria
Episodes.Description: Belqis tries to rescue her daughter from Alajan’s clutches, as Imad makes Moussa an offer he can’t refuse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ruth Ellis is arrested for killing her lover, David, with a gun in her hand. While the police see an open-and-shut case, her solicitor, John Bickford, suspects there’s more to the story.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: At the Old Bailey, Ruth faces judgment shaped by British class and legal biases. Bickford fears she’s withholding vital details that could save her. Outside the courtroom, we uncover her sacrifices for David and a toxic love triangle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Found guilty and sentenced to hang, Ruth reflects on her relationship, lost dreams, and pregnancy, as her lawyer pressures the Home Office for a reprieve. Desperate and reliant on Desmond for her son, Ruth faces the weight of her looming fate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The day before Ruth's execution, she finally agrees to tell her new lawyer, Victor Mishcon, the full story, the whole truth. Mishcon has twenty-four hours to save her life.

Entries.Title: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
Entries.Description: Tensions erupt in Bindiya around the land next to Bindiya River, forcing Chhote Davan to negotiate peace through grit. As Chhote dreams of contesting elections, his father Bada Davan publicly snatches the spotlight, triggering emotional turmoil, betrayal that sets off a deadly political chess game.

Episodes.Title: The Davan Empire
Episodes.Description: Tensions erupt in Bindiya around the land next to Bindiya River, forcing Chhote Davan to negotiate peace through grit. As Chhote dreams of contesting elections, his father Bada Davan publicly snatches the spotlight, triggering emotional turmoil, betrayal that sets off a deadly political chess game.

Episodes.Title: The Davan Family
Episodes.Description: Bada Davan is jailed for murder, but his family is torn over whether he's guilty-or being set up. Everyone in the family seems to have their own agenda and are searching for the missing ₹25 crore that could decide the future of Bindiya. Babu risks his career to uncover the truth, while Chacha takes over power.

Episodes.Title: Colonel Kaun?
Episodes.Description: With Bada Davan in jail and the family empire splintering, Chhote galvanizes public support while Chacha hunts 25 crores hidden by the dead Accountant, Lala. As both grow in power, Bada shocks them by triggering a ruthless vote within the gang to decide who becomes the next Colonel. What begins as political survival turns into emotional betrayal and a dangerous war within.

Episodes.Title: Family Tandoor
Episodes.Description: Sukki forces support for Chacha in the Colonel vote, but chaos breaks loose for Davan Family when his ego collides with mockery. Chhote fends off Murli's blackmail while juggling Ajji's dowry drama and a fractured family. As every Captain picks sides, the coup is officially underway within the family as well as outside the family.

Episodes.Title: Poonch Main Lathi
Episodes.Description: As new colonel is chosen, Chhote demands from Chacha to have no more deals with Bhamirs. Meanwhile, Kisna takes his first steps in Davan family business by threatening and bribing Murli. As Chacha schemes with Bhamir Anant Singh, a 25-crore liquor convoy heads to Patna-until on Chhote's tip, Murli's STF ambushes the route.

Episodes.Title: War Hoga
Episodes.Description: While Chhote hides 25 Crore election cash in four different portions, Babu finds that love of his life is mistress to his own brother Chhote. Chhote offers Kisna crores to leave Bindiya and Murli plots surveillance on everyone. Chacha is kidnapped by Bhamirs and the episode ends with a call for War.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Wera travels to Truskasy to scoop the breaking story from under Polgar's nose with Sokolik's help. Julia and Polgar uncover a shocking new eyewitness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The state holds a conference to unveil Polgar's findings, but when Julia and Sara visit the lake, a hidden truth about Antek's disappearance resurfaces.

Episodes.Title: The Snake
Episodes.Description: In 1981, Sunil Kumar Gupta joins Tihar Jail as a warden and learns more about its workings from DSP Rajesh Tomar. A surprise inspection leads to chaos.

Episodes.Title: Gallows
Episodes.Description: As a death warrant is issued against prisoners Ranga and Billa, journalist Pratibha Sen seeks to interview them. Sunil makes a statement to the media.

Episodes.Title: Macho
Episodes.Description: An investigation into a jailbreak holds Mangat responsible. Meanwhile, Sunil learns more about the inmates who call Tihar home.

Episodes.Title: Team Player
Episodes.Description: When an incident sparks a gang war, Tomar urges the Haddis and Tyagis to reconcile. Dahiya harbors a secret that later leads to a brawl with Sunil.

Episodes.Title: Prison Food
Episodes.Description: Sunil pushes for legal aid reforms for prisoners, but an irate Tomar decides to punish him, even as both grapple with personal troubles.

Episodes.Title: The Blanket
Episodes.Description: The prisoners stage a hunger strike amidst poor living conditions. A high-profile inmate faces execution. Sunil makes a shocking discovery.

Episodes.Title: Double Life Sentence
Episodes.Description: As nationwide riots break out, the prison falls into disarray and Tomar's leadership is questioned. Sobhraj asks Sunil for a favor.

Entries.Title: Deli Boys
Entries.Description: After their Baba's sudden death, brothers Raj and Mir realize their family's deli empire is actually a criminal front. Their survival depends on Lucky Auntie, who does something totally messed up but also kind of awesome.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: After their Baba's sudden death, brothers Raj and Mir realize their family's deli empire is actually a criminal front. Their survival depends on Lucky Auntie, who does something totally messed up but also kind of awesome.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Boys
Episodes.Description: Raj and Mir set out to find half-dead Hamza in the Forgotten Bottom, but they are idiots and nepo babies. Meanwhile, Lucky fights chauvinist Ahmad for Dark DarCo's throne, and Agent Mercer struggles to crack the FBI’s boys' club.

Episodes.Title: Delhi Boys
Episodes.Description: As Lucky, Mir, and Ahmad work to revive a smuggling operation, Ahmad's racism surfaces and Drexel’s business program gets a bad rap. Raj learns professionalism from the "Murderwalla," while Agent Mercer picks up an unexpected ally.

Episodes.Title: Delicate Boys
Episodes.Description: A Philly gangster gives the crew 24 hours to unload coke and pay his vig—but demands a hostage. Lucky screams disturbing things at Raj after he scares off the cocaine mixer, while Bushra holds Mir’s nuts to the fire.

Episodes.Title: Jersey Boys
Episodes.Description: It’s Chickie Lasagna's epic "Big Game" party, and the Pennsylvania "Football Birds" are playing. But the gang is too busy trying to expand their turf and discovering that Chickie's daughter Gigi is a hot psycho. Mercer witnesses a beatdown.

Episodes.Title: Lucky Boys
Episodes.Description: Hamza's British cousins hop across the pond on a lark, drive on the wrong side of the road, and kidnap Lucky at GMT for a wee Brexit with tea and crumpets, Stonehenge, O levels, and a Jack Russell terrier. The boys follow Raj's third eye.

Episodes.Title: Delivery Boys
Episodes.Description: The boys learn the value of work-life balance. Raj and his shaman/lover smoke a fat rosin donut en route to deliver drugs to his fiancé/business partner at West Philly Pakora Palace. Meanwhile, Mercer and Simpson finally get on the same page.

Episodes.Title: Sweaty Boys
Episodes.Description: Mercer and Simpson close in on the sticky, chewy, nutty center of the Dar crime ring. Raj rides a scooter. Mir channels his inner tech bro. Lucky pulls a fast one. Ahmad finally gets to pull down the pull-down gate outside the ABC Deli.

Episodes.Title: Shaadi Boys
Episodes.Description: On the first day of Mir and Bushra's pyari pyari shaadi, the Peruvians want their money—and it's threatening Mir's ability to be a fab dullah. Raj is acting super weird, the boys might tiff (no tiffin), and a mystery finally unravels.

Episodes.Title: Confetti Boys
Episodes.Description: Philly PD Sergeant Angelo F. Testicola fights to protect his very important crime scene despite interference from Mercer, Simpson, Raj, Mir, Lucky, Ahmad, Seema, Bushra, Chickie, Chickie's date, and Corey—the only white guy at the wedding.

Entries.Title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
Entries.Description: Kaji, the ace of the sales department, has a secret—he's gay. But dating apps have been a bust, and finding his ideal match seems impossible. Then, one day, he's sent on an overnight business trip with Fukami, a quiet, unassuming guy from the engineering team. At first, Kaji isn't impressed. But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Then, one evening, the two wind up alone together at the office. Fukami tries to leave as if nothing happened, leaving Kaji to say some pretty unexpected things to secure a second date.

Episodes.Title: Fukami and... a Girl?!
Episodes.Description: Kaji consoles a coworker who discovers he'd been dating a married man, and then happens to spot Fukami out with a lady as well, shopping for a ring! The stunned Kaji decides to ask the people at IT if Fukami has a fiancee, only to learn Fukami has been out for the last three days. A concerned Kaji heads to Fukami's house...

Episodes.Title: Say My Name
Episodes.Description: Kaji gets back the smartphone he left at Fukami's place—with Fukami's contact details snuck inside the case! Wanting to see if his feelings are the real deal, Kaji sets a date with Fukami for drinks. On the day of, however, Kaji is caught up by how cute Fukumi is, and things take them back to Kaji's place...

Episodes.Title: I Won't Go Easy On You!
Episodes.Description: Kaji is shocked to see Fukami's new haicut. But Kaji isn't the only one in the office to notice what Fukami has to offer. In a mere three days, he'd gone from a zero to a total ladies' man. Kaji is both annoyed and compelled by Fukami's obliviousness at his own appeal. Seizing the initiative, he ties up Fukami with his necktie...!

Episodes.Title: Sorry, I've Got a Cold
Episodes.Description: After walking home in the pouring rain after being pushed away by Fukami, Kaji has caught a cold. He falls asleep regretting how he told Fukami "We should stop seeing each other for a while." Awakening to the sound of someone calling his name, he sees a worried Fukami peering back at him. Caught up in the shock, Kaji graps Fukamiu close for a kiss...

Episodes.Title: I Couldn't Help But Be Attracted
Episodes.Description: Kaji thought he didn't need love in his life, but meeting Fukami changed that, and so he refuses to just give in. After a simple honest mistake, Kaji's coworker tells him he's just fine without being perfect. Kaji wonders how those words might strike Fukami, and begins to reminisce about their times together...

Episodes.Title: Is It So Bad if I Fall in Love?
Episodes.Description: Kaji goes to see Fukami at the hospital only to be asked what relation he has to the patient. Tears begin to come as he searches for an answer. Realizing how important Fukami truly is to him, the man himself appears right behind him! The two proceed to clear up their miscommunication, and make progress toward to putting aside ill will...

Episodes.Description: Reina claims that she's pregnant to take Tomoya from Misa. Reina now struggles with mounting tension from her mother-in-law. Episodes.Description: My Melody's new creation is delightfully light and airy with a satisfying crunch. Unhappy with her own recipes, Kuromi sneaks into her rival's home.

Episodes.Title: Honey Car Chase!
Episodes.Description: Everyone loves My Melody's new cupcakes, but mean online reviews upset her. Determined to uncover her baking secrets, Tanba and Sasage chase her down.

Episodes.Title: The Sweets Contest Begins
Episodes.Description: Ready, set... bake! My Melody, Flat and Piano impress the crowd with their teamwork. Can Kuromi steal the spotlight with her wild creation?

Episodes.Title: The Secret of Kuromi's Dorayaki
Episodes.Description: Kuromi's wildest dreams have come true! She's now the most popular patissier in Mariland. But Mr. Pistachio's help might be a recipe for trouble...

Episodes.Title: What Should I Do?
Episodes.Description: Chased into the forest by ravenous villagers, My Melody and Kuromi find themselves in a jam — until a thunderous voice comes to their rescue.

Episodes.Title: Time for Teamwork
Episodes.Description: As My Melody faces her home and town in ruins, Tanba and Sasage get punished for coming clean about their past. Kuromi turns to her friend for help.

Episodes.Title: To the Cloud Kingdom!
Episodes.Description: Amidst the rubble, My Melody shares her honest feelings with Kuromi. They decide to return to the Cloud Kingdom together to set things right.

Episodes.Title: Pistachio's Past
Episodes.Description: While Flat and Piano continue researching the Cloud Kingdom's history and the tragedy that befell it, My Melody and Kuromi confront Pistachio.

Episodes.Title: All for Our Best Friend
Episodes.Description: Kuromi desperately tries to awaken My Melody while Pistachio moves forward with his plan. But things turn sour as an uncontrollable rot spreads.

Episodes.Title: My Melody & Kuromi
Episodes.Description: For three days, My Melody's friends struggle to stay awake, watching over her as she dreams of her Mama's words of wisdom. Will Mariland be saved in time?

Entries.Title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
Entries.Description: Alina became a guild receptionist because she thought it'd be an easy, safe, secure job. However, in reality, she's so swamped with work that she's stuck pulling overtime day after day... and she's had enough!

Episodes.Title: I'm a Guild Receptionist, so I Want a Peaceful Life
Episodes.Description: Alina became a guild receptionist because she thought it'd be an easy, safe, secure job. However, in reality, she's so swamped with work that she's stuck pulling overtime day after day... and she's had enough!

Episodes.Title: I May Be the Executioner, but I'll Be Fired if People Find Out, so I'll Have to Use Force
Episodes.Description: Jade has found out that Alina is the Executioner and hounds her to join Silver Sword. Then a certain adventurer with a grudge sets a raid boss loose...

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Tank, but I Want to Take On a Really Tough Dungeon
Episodes.Description: Glen has learned Alina's secret and proposes a duel. If she loses, she must go to the Chalk Tower with Silver Sword.

Episodes.Title: Relics, Secret Quests, and Dark Gods Keep Interfering with My Work, so I'll Destroy Them All
Episodes.Description: The guiding crystal Jade gave Alina starts to glow, signaling that he's in peril, so Alina rushes to help.

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Healer, but Even I Could Use Some Healing
Episodes.Description: Even after nursing Jade and Lowe back to health, Lululee is depressed over the loss of her weapon and skills.

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Back Attacker, but I'm Gonna Catch the Jerk Who Started That Rumor
Episodes.Description: Alina and Silver Sword go undercover to find the source of the rumor about relics that grant Dia skills.

Episodes.Title: I've Waited Forever for the Centennial Festival, so I'm Gonna Enjoy It, No Matter What
Episodes.Description: While Alina finally enjoys her first Centennial Festival, Lululee confronts the shadows of her past.

Episodes.Title: I May Be a Useless Healer, but I'm Going to Do Everything I Can
Episodes.Description: As Alina and Jade struggle in battle against a dark god, Lululee questions her role as a healer.

Episodes.Title: I May Be in My Third Year as a Guild Receptionist, but I'm Starting New-Employee Training
Episodes.Description: Alina attends new-employee training in hopes of learning how she can avoid working overtime ever again.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost May Show Up During Training, but Nobody Told Me About It
Episodes.Description: Jade suspects that the "man in black" who's been luring adventurers into danger is someone he knows very well.

Episodes.Title: It May Be a Trap, but I Have to Keep Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Deep beneath guild HQ, Alina and Silver Sword find the "man in black," who finally reveals his identity.

Episodes.Title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, But I'll Fight to the Bitter End to Get Out of Working Overtime
Episodes.Description: Glen attacks Alina and Silver Sword ruthlessly, but they still cling to the hope of saving him.

Episodes.Description: Yuu feels down about not being able to see Atori during Golden Week. She takes another blow when she hears that Atori is going to an amusement park with a special someone.

Episodes.Description: When Yuu stays after school to do some "birdwatching," or, taking secret candid photos of Atori, she encounters Mizuka!

Episodes.Title: A Co-Ord Based on Vibes / Confession / She's Here!

Entries.Title: Ameku M.D.: Doctor Detective
Entries.Description: Ameku Takao is a genius doctor with a knack for solving all kinds of difficult cases. When a man with blue blood is brought to Tenikai General Hospital—where Takao is the vice-director—after having his leg bitten off by a large beast, she starts investigating the intriguing case with the aid of her colleague, Takanashi.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Sherlock
Episodes.Description: Ameku Takao is a genius doctor with a knack for solving all kinds of difficult cases. When a man with blue blood is brought to Tenikai General Hospital—where Takao is the vice-director—after having his leg bitten off by a large beast, she starts investigating the intriguing case with the aid of her colleague, Takanashi.

Episodes.Title: Blue Blood Cells and Dragon Fangs
Episodes.Description: Takao comes to the conclusion that the "large beast" responsible for severing the man's leg was, in fact, a Tyrannosaurus Rex. Following this shocking deduction, the case rapidly develops, and she and her crew head to the place where they hope to get answers to the remaining mystery of the victim's blue blood.

Episodes.Title: Into the Spell of Shimmering Light
Episodes.Description: "Do you believe a video can be cursed?" A girl walks in front of a train after watching a particular video and is subsequently admitted to a psych ward. Takao is the only one who believes her twin sister when she says it wasn't a suicide attempt but the result of watching a cursed video, and the genius doctor sets about investigating.

Episodes.Title: Spontaneous Human Combustion
Episodes.Description: "All who desecrate my grave shall be cursed to die." A university research team examining a grave reportedly linked to renowned onmyoji, Ashiya Doman, have started complaining about not feeling well, one after another. Takao is asked to investigate, but the case takes an unexpected turn.

Episodes.Title: Crimson Curse of the Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: Takao's diagnosis seems to solve Enzo's Curse. However, due to a mysterious death by fire, the investigation is right back at square one.

Episodes.Title: Fierce Blazing Finale
Episodes.Description: Despite another occurrence of the mysterious spontaneous human combustion phenomenon, the suspect arrested denies any involvement in either case.

Episodes.Title: Prescribed Poison
Episodes.Description: Takao gets sued for malpractice! The hospital director uses the lawsuit to push for the disbandment of the Department of Investigative Pathology.

Episodes.Title: The Night When the Angels Danced (1)
Episodes.Description: Several hospital staff report an angel in one room, and a pediatrician asks Takao for help with three children.

Episodes.Title: The Night When the Angels Danced (2)
Episodes.Description: Takao reveals the true identity of the "angel."

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (1)
Episodes.Description: Dr. Takanashi is ordered to return to the university hospital.

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (2)
Episodes.Description: Takao tries to clear Seiji's name before he is arrested by the police.

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (3)
Episodes.Description: The mystery of the drowned man is revealed.

Entries.Title: Battle of Culiacán: Heirs of the Cartel

Episodes.Title: The Chapitos
Episodes.Description: After the failed "Culiacanazo" arrest, DEA agents escalate their efforts to link the Guzmán family to the fentanyl crisis in the United States.

Episodes.Title: Hunt the Mouse
Episodes.Description: After months of surveillance, the Mexican Army -- with help from the U.S. -- launches another operation to capture Guzmán.

Episodes.Title: Burning Sinaloa
Episodes.Description: As Ovidio awaits his fate, Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada is detained in the U.S. –-- and a new surge of violence erupts in Culiacán.

Entries.Title: I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Leticia moves to her family's countryside estate and spends her time frolicking in nature. While she is fishing one day, her ex-fiancé Clarke suddenly appears. Puzzled by the visit, Leticia shows Clarke around the village and then learns a shocking fact.

Episodes.Title: I Wish you Happiness
Episodes.Description: Clarke forces Leticia to return to the castle. Upon arriving, he promises that she will be able to spend as much time in nature as she wants. Leticia starts to wonder if marriage is not such an awful idea after all, but she still yearns for more freedom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Stuck behind bars in a new room, Leticia talks to Brianna and Nadir about her hopes and dreams before noticing a hidden door during an escape attempt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: When Leticia steps out from an evening ball after seeing Clarke with another woman, she is suddenly kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With the help of her friends, Leticia temporarily leaves the castle to investigate Clarke's new mystery lover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Clarke thinks back on Leticia's early days at the castle and reevaluates his naive attempts to make her happy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Shortly after Leticia resumes her lessons, a strange incident occurs at the newly renovated conservatory bath.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Leticia recalls joyful childhood memories after Queen Laura reminds her that Prince Clarke was her first love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: With wedding preparations in full swing, rumors spread that Clarke wishes to renounce his claim to the throne.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Leticia and Clarke settle in to married life as their friends playfully encourage them to take the next step.

Episodes.Description: While a dangerous Reviver jeopardizes the peace in Wausau, Dana’s Reviver investigation becomes personal and threatens to unravel secrets she may not be ready to face.

Episodes.Description: As Wausau fractures, Dana's search brings her into conflict with a dangerous local family.

Episodes.Title: Run Along Little Lamb
Episodes.Description: A new mandate targets Revivers as Em's memories spark a violent reckoning with brutal costs.

Episodes.Title: Triage
Episodes.Description: With Dana's fate uncertain, Wayne searches for answers as Em races the clock to save her.

Episodes.Title: Bloodlines
Episodes.Description: As Wayne peels back the layers of a disturbing crime ring, Ibrahim makes a key discovery. But then a chilling abduction puts the Cypress family in danger and the clock is ticking.

Episodes.Title: Too Many Secrets
Episodes.Description: With Wausau under martial law, Wayne struggles to shield his daughters from the rising chaos, while a shocking ally emerges and changes the course of the investigation.

Episodes.Title: A Rose and a Thorn
Episodes.Description: The past collides with the present, as an old case and some old friends help Dana and Em piece together the chilling truth about Revival Day's origins.

Episodes.Title: Mother of Babylon
Episodes.Description: Dana and Wayne race to thwart Blaine Abel’s plans, as a captive Em desperately faces off with her inner demons and General Cale’s own intentions for the Revivers of Wausau.

Episodes.Title: Rend the Veil
Episodes.Description: In the shocking season finale, Dana and Em uncover the horrifying truth about Revival Day, but at an unimaginable cost that changes the Cypress family and Wausau forever.

Entries.Description: Im Se-ra is a superstar at the peak of her fame. Go Hui-yeong, an actress envious of Se-ra’s success, harbours a deep hatred toward her. Beneath her popularity, Se-ra endures a pain no one sees. During a call from Dokgo Cheol, a rookie detective, she finds comfort in him. After a car accident leaves Se-ra in a coma, she wakes up in a world that has moved on without her.

Episodes.Description: When a wallet goes missing at Jumbo Gosiwon, suspicion quickly falls on Chung-ja. Bong Chung-ja and Dokgo Cheol grow closer while searching for the person secretly trailing her. Chung-ja visits her niece to fill in the missing pieces of what happened between her and her sister, Baek-ja. After watching Go Hui-yeong at her stardom, Chung-ja becomes determined to reclaim her place.

Episodes.Title: Every Cloud Has a Silver Lining

Episodes.Title: Don't Get 'Reathers Fluffled!

Episodes.Description: In 1936, a young Roberto is sent to Guadalajara, where he struggles to fit in. Decades later, the now seasoned Chespirito finds himself lost without his biggest supporters at Channel 8, but memories of childhood help the comic conceive El Chavo del Ocho -- his most successful series yet.

Episodes.Title: He Who Laughs Last…
Episodes.Description: As El Chavo gains popularity and Roberto is given more creative freedom, Channel 8's competitors vie to bring Chespirito on board. Meanwhile, success and fame cause trouble for Roberto, his team and his family, leading to the comic's most prolific -- and devastating -- era.

Episodes.Title: The Price of Fame
Episodes.Description: With Roberto's career on the rise, the cast of El Chavo embarks on an international tour. But while her husband dives headfirst into his work, Graciela struggles with her new reality as the wife of a star.

Episodes.Title: On the Fence
Episodes.Description: As Chespirito's characters reach the height of their popularity across Latin America, Roberto relishes in his newfound level of fame -- while growing more distant from his family back home. In Acapulco, Roberto finds himself struggling with what he feels and what he thinks is right.

Episodes.Title: It Was Worth It
Episodes.Description: Roberto gets his team together for one last project -- a comedic soccer film called El Chanfle. While the cast and crew come to blows on set, Roberto faces a choice between his past and his future. Later, a warm welcome in Colombia reminds Chespirito of his true purpose: making people laugh.

Entries.Title: Ignite
Entries.Description: Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) ends up working as a lawyer at a law firm that believes that "it's good to start a dispute." He approaches his target, Misaki (Tsuchiya Tao), but a comment made by Uzaki makes her the target of his hostility..

Episodes.Title: The ones who start the fire
Episodes.Description: Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) ends up working as a lawyer at a law firm that believes that "it's good to start a dispute." He approaches his target, Misaki (Tsuchiya Tao), but a comment made by Uzaki makes her the target of his hostility..

Episodes.Title: Darkness lurking in a powerful school
Episodes.Description: Todoroki (Nakamura Toru) and others focus on Hayato (Miyachika Kaito), the younger brother of a rugby club member who attempted suicide. At a university where it is rumored that the suicide was caused by bullying within the club, Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) infiltrates a parent information session..

Episodes.Title: The Captive Sea
Episodes.Description: Kyoko (Ann Mika), who runs a diner, consults Uzaki (Shotaro Mamiya) about an injury sustained by a foreign trainee, and he and Inoo (Moka Kamishiraishi) head to the scene. However, Inoo feels a strange gaze while investigating.

Episodes.Title: The Promised Invention
Episodes.Description: They approach the president of the target company, Kazuya (Hara Yoshitaka), but he stubbornly refuses to take legal action. Todoroki (Nakamura Toru) teams up Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) and Takaido (Miyama Ryouki) to go to the person who holds the key...

Episodes.Title: The Chameleon Man
Episodes.Description: Todoroki (Nakamura Toru) asks Kiriishi (Oikawa Mitsuhiro) to corner the mayor, Otobe (Takashima Masanobu), who was involved in the cover-up of the bus accident. Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) accompanies Kiriishi, who has infiltrated the city.

Episodes.Title: The Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Uzaki (Shotaro Mamiya) suspects that Otobe (Masanobu Takashima) is responsible for the suicide of the staff, and he and Inoo (Moka Kamishiraishi) investigate him. Meanwhile, Todoroki (Toru Nakamura) is in danger of losing his attorney's license...

Episodes.Title: Inoo's Memory
Episodes.Description: Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) acts on behalf of Ayane (Ire Himeka), whose secretly taken photos have been spread around, but she asks to remain silent. Inoo (Kamishiraishi Moka) confides in Ayane about her own past...

Episodes.Title: Love or Justice?
Episodes.Description: Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) and his team are investigating a case involving a client who wants to sue Toua Hospital, which is connected to GI Technologies. However, the surgeon who will be operating on Kiriishi's (Oikawa Mitsuhiro) wife, is the subject of the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 0
Episodes.Description: Five years ago, Todoroki (Nakamura Toru) reconsidered his father's behavior and planned to spend his teenage daughter Kana's (Fujisaki Yumia) birthday with his daughter. On the day of the birthday celebration, he was racking his brains over what to give her as a present...

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Uzaki (Mamiya Shotaro) and Inoo (Kamishiraishi Moka) visit the company where Yusuke (Miyagawa Ichirota) worked for the first time to investigate the bus accident. Meanwhile, Asami (Ryo) has his sights set on a certain person...

Episodes.Title: Last Ignite
Episodes.Description: Just when the truth is about to be revealed, an unexpected event occurs that shakes even Uzaki's (Mamiya Shotaro) sense of justice. What will be the fate of the "outlaws"?

Episodes.Title: My Embroidery Sold

Episodes.Title: Using Magic to Visit the Capital

Episodes.Description: With the help of Marin's invention, Satoko tries a new ninja skill: Breast Storage Ninjutsu!

Episodes.Title: An Assassin and Her Classmate's Friend

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Big House
Episodes.Description: Satoko and Konoha move out, but it appears they're not alone in their big new house.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Experiment
Episodes.Description: Satoko needs to find a new iconic outfit and find out the extent of her ninjutsu's capabilities.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and a Baby Assassin

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Big Dilemma
Episodes.Description: Satoko's injured and Konoha takes on challenging missions due to her career and life being on the line.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: As Satoko waits to hear back from Konoha, she gets a few upgrades. But will Konoha come home safe and sound?

Entries.Title: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!

Episodes.Title: Dad Makes a Pun!

Episodes.Title: Dad Summons a Beast
Episodes.Description: The day the students' familiars hatch arrives at long last. Meanwhile, in another world, two women must come to terms with the fate of a beloved husband and father.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets Into Dual-wielding
Episodes.Description: Impressed by a rare accomplishment, the principal asks Grace aka Kenzaburo to participate in the Magic Exhibition.

Episodes.Title: Dad is Moved to Tears
Episodes.Description: Grace and Anna have both proven their worth time and time again. Unfortunately, there are those who insist on sowing division between them.

Episodes.Title: Dad Puts On an Exhibition
Episodes.Description: Grace’s father returns after a business trip, but proves he doesn’t know his daughter very well. However, as a fellow father, Kenzaburo understands that the man is trying.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Maid
Episodes.Description: Grace aka Kenzaburo invites Anna to stay at the Auvergne estate over the summer when it becomes clear she still needs to learn the ins and outs of high society.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets Trapped
Episodes.Description: When the student council gets trapped in a labyrinth, it's up to Grace aka Kenzaburo and Anna to save everyone.

Episodes.Title: Dad Cross-Dresses
Episodes.Description: Grace aka Kenzaburo goes incognito to visit the bakery that Anna's family runs, but Anna's mother quickly deduces Grace's identity.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets into an Elegant Pickle!
Episodes.Description: The student council decides to put on a gender-swapping play with Anna in the lead role! Unfortunately, Anna overworks herself to the point of collapse.

Episodes.Title: Dad Celebrates at the Campus Festival
Episodes.Description: The Elegance Cheat has a fatal flaw: Grace aka Kenzaburo can't perform without everything becoming unnecessarily fancy!

Entries.Title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
Entries.Description: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!

Episodes.Title: Mickey's New Helper
Episodes.Description: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!

Episodes.Title: Clarabelle's New Coop
Episodes.Description: When Clarabelle's coop is wrecked, Mickey and friends rebuild it using Mouseketools, giving her chickens a new, improved home!

Episodes.Title: Goofy's Sock Hunt
Episodes.Description: Goofy's socks vanish during naps, and soon Mickey's stuff goes missing too! They find Pluto gathering items to build a cozy bed for a mama cat and her kittens.

Episodes.Title: Puppy Pluto
Episodes.Description: Professor Von Drake's Itty Bitty Baby Ray turns him and Pluto into babies! Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to reverse the shrink ray.

Episodes.Title: Goofy Pizza
Episodes.Description: Goofy's hungry for pizza, but the fridge is missing ingredients. Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to gather what's needed and make a delicious pizza to share!

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Tune Train
Episodes.Description: Professor Von Drake gifts a calliope car for the Clubhouse Choo-Choo train. Minnie performs a song, and she and Mickey help friends finish chores to join in.

Episodes.Title: Please the Bees
Episodes.Description: Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Dinner Party
Episodes.Description: The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Backpack Adventure
Episodes.Description: Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.

Episodes.Title: Mickey's Mail Mix-Up
Episodes.Description: Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.

Entries.Title: Momentary Lily
Entries.Description: In a lonely city where all the inhabitants have been erased by mysterious machines, Renge encounters a team of girls who have been fighting the machines. She cooks them a meal.

Episodes.Title: Saury Hitsumabushi After the Loneliness

Episodes.Title: Canned Mackerel Italian-style Tomato Hot Pot Together
Episodes.Description: Now that Renge has joined the group's ranks with her powerful weapon, Yuri feels capable of confronting the Goliath, a huge machine, and continuing to advance.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Canned Crab and Canned Mackerel Chirashi Sushi
Episodes.Description: With Yuri having passed away, the team must decide what to do next. The photos being posted on social media may offer a clue.

Episodes.Title: Rich and Warm Corn Beef Miso Ramen
Episodes.Description: A sudden snowstorm forces the girls to take refuge in a school.

Episodes.Title: Wishing On Mackerel, Oyster, and Egg Zosui Soup Kuzushi Kiritampo Style
Episodes.Description: The relationship between Erika and Hinageshi becomes strained. A duel between the big sister and the gamer begins.

Episodes.Title: Pool Videos, Summer and Shanghai-style Squid Yakisoba
Episodes.Description: The team makes videos by the pool to prove on social media that they are humans.

Episodes.Title: Fighting Together for Shio Musubi
Episodes.Description: The team fights a large group of Wild Hunt threatening what appears to be Citron's group.

Episodes.Title: Chocolate Bars Once the Rain Stops
Episodes.Description: Renge meets Suzuran and discovers that she may not be who -- or what -- she thinks she is.

Episodes.Title: Laughed All Night and Put Lots of Secret Ingredients in a Surprisingly Tasty Curry
Episodes.Description: Suzuran's group prepares to move to Citron's settlement.

Episodes.Title: One More and a Missing Can
Episodes.Description: The team chase Yuri into a station and discover more than they can wrap their head around.

Episodes.Title: Cooking Together With the Untouchable Girl
Episodes.Description: Hinageshi hacks the facility's AI, forcing it to explain its role.

Episodes.Title: Such A Fun Full-Course Meal
Episodes.Description: Balor approaches. It's up to the copies -- and Renge -- to protect the survivors.

Episodes.Title: Ending on an Ochazuke Buffet with Everyone Around
Episodes.Description: The girls continued their fierce battle in "Everyone's Ochazuke Buffet."

Entries.Description: After decades of no contact, the “Happy Face Killer” and his daughter are begrudgingly reunited, in order for her to find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime he committed.

Episodes.Description: After decades of no contact, the “Happy Face Killer” and his daughter are begrudgingly reunited, in order for her to find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime he committed.

Episodes.Title: Killing Shame
Episodes.Description: Melissa and Ivy travel to Texas to learn everything about Heather Richmond's murder.

Episodes.Title: Was It Worth It?
Episodes.Description: Melissa navigates the highs and lows of going public with her story.

Episodes.Title: Controlled Burn
Episodes.Description: Ben tries to keep his family safe as Hazel receives an unexpected invitation.

Episodes.Title: Don't Dream
Episodes.Description: When crucial evidence goes missing, Melissa creates an unlikely alliance to solve the problem.

Episodes.Title: Lorelai
Episodes.Description: Melissa and Ivy find unknown footage of Heather performing that changes everything.

Episodes.Title: My Jesperson Girls
Episodes.Description: Melissa faces a dark family secret that leads her back to Ash.

Episodes.Title: The Star
Episodes.Description: Melissa solves the case. Keith suffers an attack. Ben faces consequences for his actions.

Entries.Title: Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time
Entries.Description: Takumi Iruma is summoned to another world by chance. Since the goddess Nolyn cannot bring him back to his world, he is supposed to live in her fantasy world Mildgard. There, Takumi immediately saves a young girl and is taken to her village.

Episodes.Title: I Was Summoned By Accident
Episodes.Description: Takumi Iruma is summoned to another world by chance. Since the goddess Nolyn cannot bring him back to his world, he is supposed to live in her fantasy world Mildgard. There, Takumi immediately saves a young girl and is taken to her village.

Episodes.Title: To a New Land
Episodes.Description: Maple, the spider monster that Takumi meets in the forest and Tames, possesses the Skill to create Spider Silk, an extreme luxury good! The silk becomes a hit amongst the villagers, and they welcome Takumi and his unique Skills as he grows accustomed to life in the village.

Episodes.Title: Contracts and Oaths
Episodes.Description: In order to create 100 of the toilets equipped with a magic device that Papek begged him for, Takumi visits the Mulan Company to procure help. After requesting "someone to the manage the mansion" and "someone capable of fighting and protecting me", Takumi meets a beautiful human girl, Maria, and a beautiful elf, Sofia.

Episodes.Title: Takumi Party's First Battle!
Episodes.Description: Takumi informs Maria and Sofia that he'd like to travel, so he registers them both with the Adventurer's Guild and forms an official party. After Takumi sends some of the guild's troublemakers packing, he's approached by the Guild Master and advised to quickly rank up his party, so the three head out together on a Quest to defeat goblins.

Episodes.Title: Shadow of Sidonia
Episodes.Description: Takumi wants to upgrade their gear for their journey, so he seeks out mythril and admantite ores. After consulting with the Adventurer's Guild, he accepts Quests to defeat monsters, gather Treant Wood, and escort a miner to excavate the ores. He plans to set out in three days time with the blacksmith, Dgambo.

Episodes.Title: A Drake Horse Appears
Episodes.Description: Word of Takumi's Purification magic device has reached the Holy Empire of Sidonia, and they demand that the Kingdom of Barcula hand over Takumi, but they refuse.

Episodes.Title: The Fox-Eared Girl of the Royal Capital
Episodes.Description: After welcoming the Drake Horse, Camellia, to his party, Takumi redoubles his efforts to build his carriage. Sofia starts to worry as he works with fervor and refuses to rest. The carriage is safely completed and they begin their journey to the Royal Capital with Marquis Godwin on board.

Episodes.Title: Let's Choose a Party Name!
Episodes.Description: After welcoming Reyva to their group, they complete the carriage to be offered to the king of Barcula.

Episodes.Title: Resolve
Episodes.Description: Takumi strengthens his defenses by creating a barrier and taming an Iron Golem named Titan, while the Emperor temporarily leaves him alone to focus on summoning heroes, and Nolyn fears the Church of Divine Light may inadvertently manifest an evil goddess.

Episodes.Title: Takumi Takes on Pioneering!
Episodes.Description: Takumi's group challenges the dungeon, Forest of the Beast King, and strengthens their bonds. Around that time Marquis Godwin consults with Takumi, and asks him to help create a pioneer village in the undeveloped lands to the south of his domain in order to secure a place for the refugees from a deserted village nearby.

Episodes.Title: Signs of Turmoil
Episodes.Description: Máni joins the Wings of Nolyn as they build the fortress town of Wedgefort, which grows more prosperous by the day. However, the Holy Empire of Sidonia activates their Hero Summoning, which causes the mana in the region to fluctuate, increasing the strength of the monsters outside the fortress' ramparts.

Episodes.Title: When Bonds Are Tested
Episodes.Description: Wedgefort is assaulted by a horde of monsters, and word of the emergency reaches Takumi. The Wings of Nolyn, Lion Fang, and Crimson Rose accept the Quest, and together the three parties fend off the assault, but the knights they fought alongside mention something concerning.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Episodes.Title: Episode 6

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Seok learns Deokhee has been lying to her as she sets up her next operating room.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Seok's dark past finally comes to light, with time quickly running out for both her and Deokhee.

Entries.Title: Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes

Episodes.Title: On the Prowl
Episodes.Description: As his murder count rises, so does Berkowitz's brazenness as he toys with the media. Later, the origin of his "Son of Sam" alias is revealed.

Episodes.Title: No One Is Safe
Episodes.Description: With the public's fear growing more intense by the day, the police desperately search for the break they need.

Entries.Title: Leviathan
Entries.Description: 1914. Prince Alek of Austria-Hungary goes on an unusual practice session in a Stormwalker. In Edinburgh, Sharp eagerly takes flight in a Huxley.

Episodes.Title: Into the Storm
Episodes.Description: 1914. Prince Alek of Austria-Hungary goes on an unusual practice session in a Stormwalker. In Edinburgh, Sharp eagerly takes flight in a Huxley.

Episodes.Title: Prelude to War
Episodes.Description: As Europe teeters on the edge of an all-out war, Alek struggles with his new life in hiding. Sharp gets acquainted with the Leviathan and its crew.

Episodes.Title: Clankers and Darwinists
Episodes.Description: Alek learns why he's hunted and, despite Volger's advice, sneaks out to aid the Leviathan's crew. He saves Sharp, who doesn't buy the prince's story.

Episodes.Title: The Weight of the Past
Episodes.Description: With Clanker forces hot on their tail, the wounded Leviathan needs a miracle to get off the ground. Alek makes an offer the Darwinists can't refuse.

Episodes.Title: Far to the East
Episodes.Description: The Leviathan encounters a deadly Clanker weapon on its journey towards Istanbul. Upon arriving in the city, Alek and his comrades make plans to escape.

Episodes.Title: Shadows of Istanbul
Episodes.Description: Sharp and Dr. Barlow finally meet the Sultan, hoping to smooth things over with a rare gift. Meanwhile, a mysterious girl saves Alek from a German patrol.

Episodes.Title: Stormy Seas
Episodes.Description: A patrol jeopardizes the British secret operation, forcing Sharp to flee into Istanbul's streets. Alek commits himself to the revolutionary army's cause.

Episodes.Title: Behemoth
Episodes.Description: On the day of the coup, Alek urges Klopp to leave for his safety. Later, unexpected news forces the revolutionaries to act before the Behemoth arrives.

Episodes.Title: Tunguska
Episodes.Description: The Leviathan and its crew arrive in Siberia to meet Barlow's uncle. He reveals the source behind numerous mysterious phenomena around the world.

Episodes.Title: Truth and Lies
Episodes.Description: Tensions run high after Alek learns the truth about his friend. But before they can talk things over, Sharp gets into a dangerous predicament.

Episodes.Title: Goliath
Episodes.Description: Determined to uncover the truth about Tunguska, Alek and Sharp confront Tesla and learn about the invention responsible for the destruction: the Goliath.

Episodes.Title: Under the Same Sky
Episodes.Description: Tesla issues a deadly ultimatum as a last resort. Can Sharp and Alek, stuck on opposing sides, prevent the conflict from escalating before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Tastefully Yours

Episodes.Title: The Stubbornness of Jungjae
Episodes.Description: Yeon-joo signs a deal with Beom-woo—under certain conditions. They soon fight over every detail, from hiring to plating, until they find their groove.

Episodes.Title: Partially Soaked
Episodes.Description: As false rumours of Jungjae's failure spread through town, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo hit snag after snag—until a frightening incident shakes the restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Love is Like a Spark
Episodes.Description: As the Jungjae team preps for the food truck competition, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo clash over their approach—but soon join forces for a shot at victory.

Episodes.Description: After a tender moment between Yeon-joo and Beom-woo, an unexpected figure appears. The Jungjae team prepares for an international wedding tasting.

Episodes.Description: Beom-woo, Jin Myung-sook and Shin Choon-seung struggle to fill Yeon-joo's void when she unexpectedly disappears—until Beom-woo sets out to find her.

Episodes.Title: The Restaurant I Loved
Episodes.Description: In Japan, Beom-woo and Yeon-joo grow closer as she prepares a recipe for her former boss. Beom-woo confronts Jeon Min about his intentions with Yeon-joo.

Episodes.Title: Scorched Recipe
Episodes.Description: As Beom-woo scrambles to clean up a mess of his own making, the Jungjae team heads out on a trip—and his feelings for Yeon-joo deepen even more.

Episodes.Title: Imperfect Cooking
Episodes.Description: The shocking truth shatters Yeon-joo and Beom-woo's relationship, leaving them both devastated. But soon, they receive surprising news about Jungjae.

Episodes.Title: Tastefully Yours
Episodes.Description: Jungjae goes head-to-head with Motto in a showdown of taste. Can Beom-woo and Yeon-joo overcome their differences to come out on top?

Entries.Title: Homicide Squad New Orleans

Episodes.Title: My Sister's Keeper
Episodes.Description: Detective Maurice Stewart investigates the murder of Raynard Williams Jr, a 15-year-old boy, who was gunned down after walking his younger sister home.

Episodes.Title: In  Cold Blood
Episodes.Description: Det. Walter Edmond responds to a homicide where a woman is found dead from multiple gunshot wounds, and a couple at the scene leads him to a suspect. Surveillance footage and ballistics evidence link the suspect to two murders.

Episodes.Title: Mardi Gras Murder
Episodes.Description: Amid the vibrant chaos of New Orleans' Mardi Gras celebrations, gunshots shatter the festive atmosphere of the French Quarter, leaving a man dead. Detective James Fyfe takes on the investigation, determined to bring closure to the victim's grieving family despite the challenges of solving a murder in one of the city's busiest seasons.

Episodes.Title: Know Thy Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Lead Detective Tanisha Sykes Smith tackles the case of a lifetime resident of the Lower 9th Ward found murdered a block away from his mother’s home. Detective Smith works the case step-by-step to apprehend the alleged shooter.

Episodes.Title: A Mother's Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Detective Rayell Johnson investigates the murder of a 42-year-old New Orleans native, who was gunned down in his truck on a stormy night.

Episodes.Title: Afternoon Ambush
Episodes.Description: With the help of Det. Johnson and Det. Stewart, Det. Diesburg pieces together what happened one Saturday afternoon when two teens fired rifles on two other teens driving down the street in a residential neighborhood in the 6th district.

Episodes.Title: A Witness to Murder
Episodes.Description: Detective Arthur Hill is on the case to catch a suspected killer, but he's relying on a witness who is fearful because they survived a gunshot from the suspect. Meanwhile, Detective Stewart is called to a busy intersection where an elderly woman suffers a horrible attack from a homeless man armed with a knife.

Episodes.Title: Caught in 4K
Episodes.Description: Lead Detective Joseph Herman works the case of Brittany Ussin, a young woman gunned down after a fist fight live streamed on social media goes wrong.

Episodes.Title: No Good Deed
Episodes.Description: With the help of his partner, Det. Arthur Hill, Det. Maurice Stewart tracks down the killers of a good Samaritan who was attempting to stop a crime in progress.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie
Episodes.Description: Aided by the know-how of veteran officers in the department and his own investigative skills, Rookie Detective Donnie Willyard tracks down a suspect who allegedly shot a man in the front entrance of his home nearly 10 times.

Episodes.Title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
Episodes.Description: Detective Tanisha Sykes Smith searches for the individuals responsible for the tragic murder of an innocent bystander, who was caught in crossfire during a heated dispute in the French Quarter.

Episodes.Title: Digital Grudge
Episodes.Description: An online dispute turns into a physical fight that ends with a mother losing her life; as Det. Fyfe unravels names of possible suspects, he zeroes in on a gang that has been terrorizing the city.

Episodes.Title: Beware Thy Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Detective Maurice Stewart investigates the murder of a woman, who was allegedly gunned down by her neighbour after an argument over cats and dogs.
